name: burgers
description: Periodic one-dimensional finite-volume Burgers equation; backward Euler with a colored finite-difference Jacobian.
notes: The default grid has 1025 scalar unknowns. For this periodic width-two DMDA coloring, use da_grid_x divisible by 5 (for example 1025 or 4095).
Keep snes_fd_color to export the full residual Jacobian rather than the tutorial approximate Jacobian.
